propositions: Four agent criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 runs due to missing or overly broad applicability detection.

Deterministic pre-filter gates must fire only when criterion vocabulary is present in plan text or file impact metadata, skipping LLM routing entirely when absent, with zero false negatives across the audit evasion test set.
Asserted-capability requires both module-ref and capability-verb regex legs to match (conjunction); single-leg matches must not fire.

File impact path globs (T14) and reason-text regexes (removal-rationale) must fire independently of plan description text, enabling detection when declarative metadata indicates removal or scheduling work.
Skip events must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with the non-firing rule name, visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar for every skipped criterion.
Migrated overlay trigger rules (T5a, T5d, T7, T12) must preserve existing fire/no-fire behavior compared to current plain-regex implementations.
